title: Reuse resolved Body frames in appearance baking
description: Performance correctness slice discovered while tracing the user-supplied Quality 16 AppearanceBake hotspot. BodyVerticalGradientSampler exposes a frames-aware EvaluateColor overload specifically to reuse ResolvedCreatureSnapshot.BodyFrames, but AppearanceBaker's Burst path was calling the convenience overload and therefore recomputing BodyFrameResolver.ComputeSampleFrames for every Body-winning vertex. Route the main generation path through snapshot.BodyFrames; compatibility callers without a snapshot must derive frames once per bake, never once per vertex. Preserve exact authored Gradient/AnimationCurve behavior and add parity coverage.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Implemented in commit cac197c8322619239b9e11decc46771482108c3d. AppearanceBaker.BakeBurst now takes snapshot.BodyFrames on the main generation path and derives frames once for compatibility callers without a snapshot. The four-argument BodyVerticalGradientSampler convenience overload is no longer used per vertex by the generation path. Unity benchmark/parity validation is pending.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Second static council re-audit 2026-09-11: the snapshot frame reuse remains structurally correct. No new defect was found in this task. Keep InProgress until Unity parity confirms exact Body gradient colors and fresh profiling demonstrates the intended AppearanceBake reduction. A separate remaining O(vertices × body-segments) arc-length prefix walk is tracked by TSK-0202 rather than folded into this task.
